feature_title: Logs Refresh Cache & Run Query Dropdown

rationale.edition: Every changed path lives in the open-source frontend and test tree: web/src/plugins/logs/SearchBar.vue, web/src/components/dashboards/PanelContainer.vue, their Vitest specs, and tests/ui-testing/**. None are under enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or src/enterprise/. The change actively REMOVES enterprise gating (the config.isEnterprise == 'true' v-if conditions on the dropdown items are deleted), so this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: No skip applies. feature_hint.txt and trigger_comment.txt are both empty and no tests-added/opt-out label was passed, so there is no explicit opt-out. The diff is not docs/CI-only: it modifies user-facing Vue components (SearchBar.vue, PanelContainer.vue), so it is a user-facing behavior change.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted: the change alters a real UI flow — the 'Refresh Cache & Run Query' dropdown in the Logs SearchBar is now shown unconditionally (no longer gated by auto_query_enabled or enterprise build) and its item must be visible on both the Logs and Visualize tabs, and the dashboard PanelContainer 'refresh without cache' item is no longer enterprise-only. These are user-exercisable visibility/click behaviors that Playwright should verify.
rationale.area: The bulk of the UI change is in web/src/plugins/logs/SearchBar.vue (Logs search bar dropdown). The companion PanelContainer.vue change is a dashboard panel dropdown, but the diff's own E2E spec was placed under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Logs/, and the primary user flow (Refresh Cache & Run Query on the Logs/Visualize tabs) belongs to the Logs area.
rationale.group: The new spec lives in the Logs area, and the closest existing matrix shard is Logs-Core (actual_folder Logs), which already holds logspage.spec.js, logstable.spec.js, shareLink.spec.js and other Logs-page specs; logsRefreshCacheDropdown.spec.js belongs alongside them rather than the query-focused Logs-Queries shard.
rationale.existing_tests: Yes — the diff adds tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Logs/logsRefreshCacheDropdown.spec.js, a new Playwright E2E spec covering exactly this feature (visibility on the Logs and Visualize tabs plus the clear_cache=true request). The other changed test files (PanelContainer.spec.ts and SearchBar.refreshCacheDropdown.spec.ts) are Vitest unit tests and do not count as E2E coverage.
